lastCompletedStory.title: Append the derive-don't-freeze rule for main-derived comparands as a new EOF bullet

nextStoryContext: US-002 (CAM-377) appended one new bullet at scripts/cam/patterns.md:903 (after a blank separator at :902), pure EOF append: lines 1-901 are byte-identical to main (verified via diff against git show main:scripts/cam/patterns.md for both the 1-898 pinning range and the 899 boundary line). File grew from 901 to 903 lines. The new bullet states the derive-don't-freeze rule for main-derived acceptance-criterion comparands, names the concrete idiom `git show main:<path>|wc -l` (deliberately no space before the pipe -- required for the story's own oracle regex `git show main:[^ ]*\|[[:space:]]*wc -l` to match: a space before `|` breaks the `[^ ]*` non-space run), and explicitly distinguishes itself from the falsifiability rule at patterns.md:899 (899 = prove the oracle CAN go red via a sweep; this new bullet = once it can, derive its main-sourced comparand live rather than freezing a literal). review-artifact mention count in patterns.md is untouched at 3. US-003 (next, no story dependency on US-002's diff) is the worked example this same CAM-377/patterns.md:899 lineage cites by issue number: test/dispatch.test.ts:754 has a non-falsifiable `ms <= 1_000` backoff-bound assertion that must be strengthened and proven falsifiable via a temporary local mutation (revert before commit), with the mutation and both before/after results recorded verbatim in handoff.json per its own acceptance criteria. US-003's notes explicitly call out reusing this story's derive-don't-freeze idiom if the replacement assertion pins a poll-interval-derived value.
